description: Identifies the walking skeleton as the minimum end-to-end viable release
input: From these stories for a skill catalog, identify the walking skeleton: search skills, filter by category, preview skill content, one-click deploy, install count tracking, ratings, forking, version history.
required: walking skeleton is minimum end-to-end path
search or browse and deploy are core minimum
ratings and forking are not in walking skeleton
forbidden: include all features in walking skeleton
